summary: Test-writing run for issue #39. Added (1) a committed solver-parity corpus fixture with a reference-verified expected-value set, (2) SolverParityCorpusTests (scorer-level + production-solver-level selection parity incl. exact ties, exclusions, weight handling), (3) PaletteAPIClientBehaviorTests pinning the /api/v1 wire contract and the offline-stale disk-cache fallback the generated-client migration must preserve, (4) GeneratedClientAdoptionTests as red-phase guards for the swift-openapi-generator/runtime adoption, and (5) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. IMPORTANT: no Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container (macOS-only project), so `swift test` could not be executed here; corpus expected values were instead computed and cross-checked with a Python reference implementation of the documented scorer semantics (canonical channel order, strict-< earliest-wins ties, candidate- and target-side exclusion), including bit-identical tie verification and the Elixir doctest value 0.205.
environment_limitations: `swift`/`xcrun`/`xcodebuild` are not installed in this container (Linux, macOS-only project), so no Swift test could be run locally.

Dependencies viamin/color_matching#110 (OpenAPI spec) and #111 (parity corpus) are not published to this repo; the committed corpus is a hand-authored placeholder whose provenance is recorded in its `source` field, structured for replacement by the generated corpus.

references.result: not_run — parity findings for the PR body: ties are exact (identical vectors and symmetric mirrors both tie bit-identically) and resolve earliest-wins; exclusions apply candidate-side (missing required measurement) and target-side (all candidates excluded → no selection); weight handling: zero-weight channels are not required, positive weights scale squared contributions and flip selection deterministically; doctest 0.205 reproduced at 0.20499999999999996 (float accumulation, within 1e-9). /api/v1 shape finding: current wire contract is snake_case envelopes {printer_profiles:[...]} and {colors:[...], printer_profile:{...}} — pinned by PaletteAPIClientBehaviorTests for the migration.
